fields.default_value: Straight answers on payment, activation, refunds, devices and how many screens you get.

fields.label: FAQ – Questions
fields.name: lp_faq_items
fields.instructions: Each row is one accordion panel. The FIRST row renders open; all others render closed (their answer is still in the HTML, carrying the hidden attribute). Leave both link fields empty for a row with no link. Rows 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 have no link by default.

sub_fields.label: Question
sub_fields.name: question
sub_fields.default_value: What happens right after I pay?

sub_fields.label: Answer
sub_fields.name: answer
sub_fields.default_value: Your IPTV subscription is activated automatically — nothing is queued for manual approval. Within about 2 to 5 minutes you get an email with your login details: an M3U playlist link plus your Xtream Codes username and password. The same line also appears under My IPTV Lines in your member panel. Paste the link into a free player such as TiviMate, IPTV Smarters or IBO Player Pro and you are watching in 4K. If the email is not there, check your spam folder before anything else.

fields.label: FAQ – Bottom bar text
fields.name: lp_faq_cta_text
fields.instructions: Text in the grey bar under the accordion.
fields.default_value: Have a question that isn't answered here?

fields.label: FAQ – Bottom bar link text
fields.name: lp_faq_cta_link_text
fields.instructions: Link at the right of the grey bar. It always points at the in-page anchor #need-help-section, so only the label is editable.

fields.label: Guarantee – Badge Text
fields.name: lp_guar_badge
fields.instructions: Small uppercase pill above the heading. Keep it short – it sits on one line next to a lightning icon.

fields.label: Guarantee – Heading (before highlight)
fields.name: lp_guar_title_before
fields.instructions: First part of the H2, rendered in near-black. A space is added automatically before the blue highlight.

fields.label: Guarantee – Heading (blue highlight)
fields.name: lp_guar_title_highlight
fields.instructions: Middle of the H2, rendered in brand blue (#007CEB).

fields.label: Guarantee – Heading (after highlight)
fields.name: lp_guar_title_after
fields.instructions: Last part of the H2, rendered in near-black. A space is added automatically after the blue highlight.

fields.label: Guarantee – Subtitle
fields.name: lp_guar_subtitle
fields.instructions: One paragraph under the heading. Plain text only – no HTML is rendered here.
fields.default_value: Our load-balanced CDN servers distribute traffic across 180+ global data centers to ensure crisp 60FPS stream stability during derbies, finals and title deciders.

fields.label: Guarantee – Button Label
fields.name: lp_guar_cta_label
fields.instructions: Label inside the blue button. Displayed uppercase by the design; keep it to a few words so the button stays on one line.

fields.label: Guarantee – Trust Row
fields.name: lp_guar_trust_items
fields.instructions: The small icon + text items in the row below the button. Leave empty to use the three defaults. Icon must be one of: globe, server, shield-check (globe and shield-check render green, server renders blue).
